description:
Lot of 5 Vintage Glass Electrical Insulators Hemingray Blue Green Clear
This lot includes 5 vintage glass electrical insulators featuring both aqua/blue-green and clear glass varieties. Two blue-green insulators are marked with 'HEMINGRAY' and 'MADE IN U.S.A.'. Each insulator is made of heavy, thick glass with a classic double-groove design. Most pieces exhibit signs of age including minor dirt, residue, and surface wear but have no major cracks or chips visible. The clear glass insulators include one with a partial label and some with embossed markings. These insulators were originally used on telegraph and power lines and are suitable for collectors or as decorative industrial items.
9 x 8 x 4 in

10 Piece Lot with Storage Case
Type I and Type II Formulations
This collection features 10 vintage blank audio cassette tapes from leading manufacturers TDK, Maxell, and Memorex. These tapes represent the standard for analog home recording from the late 1980s through the 1990s, offering a mix of Type I Normal Bias and Type II High Position (Chrome) formulations. The lot is accompanied by a TDK-branded soft nylon carrying case designed for secure storage and transport of a cassette library.
5 TDK High Position Type II tapes: includes two SA-90 and three SA-X100 cassettes

TDK/Coast branded black nylon soft case with zipper closure and internal organizers
Condition:
All 10 cassette tapes are factory sealed in their original cellophane packaging. The nylon storage case is in good condition with a fully functional zipper and intact interior slots. The external branding and logo patches are clear and legible. Sold as-is due to the nature of vintage magnetic media.

description:
Hemingray Glass Insulators Lot - 3 Pieces
Hemingray Glass Company, No. 17 and Patent 1893 Models
Aqua Blue and Clear, Vintage 19th to 20th Century
This collection features three vintage glass insulators produced by the Hemingray Glass Company, once the world's largest manufacturer of glass insulators. These utilitarian pieces were originally designed to support telegraph and telephone wires, and are now highly sought after for their iconic industrial aesthetic and diverse color variations.
Pieces Included:
Insulator, Aqua Blue glass, marked "HEMINGRAY" and "PATENT MAY 2 1893," featuring sharp drip points on the base edge.
Insulator, Clear glass, marked "HEMINGRAY-17," featuring a smooth flared base with a textured grip ring.
Insulator, Clear glass, marked "HEMINGRAY-17," featuring a smooth flared base with a textured grip ring.
Condition:
The aqua blue insulator shows significant internal soot or carbon deposits and surface grime from authentic outdoor service. The clear insulators show minor surface wear and occasional internal bubbles characteristic of molded utility glass. No significant structural cracks are observed, though minor fleabites consistent with industrial usage may be present along the base edges.

Clear glass with a subtle light aqua tint characteristic of period glass production

For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping
Flat-rate shipping charges are fixed and
cannot be adjusted or discounted
.
When multiple flat-rate items are purchased together, the shipping charge for each item is added to the order. For example, if three items each have a $5.99 flat-rate shipping charge, the total shipping charge will be $17.97
Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.

When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.

Silver-tone metal construction with hand-applied filigree and wirework decoration

shipping.policy:
Payment:
The only methods of payment we accept are Visa, Master Card, and Discover Card. We do not accept cash, checks, or any other form of payment.
Sales tax will be figured and added to each purchase based on the rate and requirement from your state.
Shipping:
Upon receipt of payment, we utilize Fedex and USPS as our primary shipping carriers. Shipments to P.O. Boxes will be shipped by USPS. We do our best to have items shipped within 7 business days from the date of payment; we are not open on weekends. We are limited to the carriers’ rules and regulations when shipping an order. Shipping charges are calculated at time of payment. Please check shipping rates prior to placing your bid. All items will be shipped as listed and will not be dismantled for any reason.
Minimum shipment weight is 1 lb. Items weighing less than 1 lb. will be calculated at the 1 lb. rate.
Please check shipping rates prior to placing your bid.
Combined Orders:
Multiple items can be combined PRIOR TO the checkout process provided that the payment deadline has not expired on any of the items that you are combining to create the order, and that the combined weight does not exceed 20 pounds. Combined shipping must be requested by the customer prior to payment; it is not automatically allowed. Once an item has been paid for, it is no longer eligible for combined shipping. We reserve the right to deny combination of certain items.
Insurance:
Buyer must email a request for insurance prior to making payment. Insurance cannot be added by the buyer during the payment process. An e-mail must be sent to us and we will then edit the order total for you.
We apologize, but if your package is damaged or lost we will not be able to issue a refund unless your package was insured. We strongly recommend insurance on all breakable items. Photos will be required before a refund will be considered.
Handling Fee:
A minimum of $3.00 handling fee will appear at checkout and applies to all purchases regardless of delivery method or pick up. Our handling fee is a set fee and cannot be adjusted. (Certain items that are very fragile, irregularly shaped, and/or heavy may be subject to an increased handling fee.) These fees, along with your purchase, help to support our Goodwill mission.

DISCLAIMER: This item is pre-owned and was donated to GoodwillSONT, and may contain unseen flaws and imperfections in addition to the information listed here. Goodwill Industries of Southwestern Oklahoma and North Texas will not be held responsible for items lost or stolen that show being delivered by the carrier's tracking. All orders that sell for $100.00 or more will automatically receive "signature required" shipping at no added cost to the customer. If you are concerned with having your item delivered to your home address, you can visit FedEx.com and have your item either held at a FedEx facility or a Walgreen's near you. Signature required delivery can be purchased for an additional $3.99; please reach out to us prior to completing payment. Once payment has been made, we will not be able to add "signature required".

These 3pc crystal gemstone lot features raw druzy calcite quartz geodes and a blue bookend agate slice, suitable for collectors, display, or educational use.

description:
Sheaffer
Ballpoint Pen and Mechanical Pencil Set - Pepsi Advertising Edition
1980s Era, Black Matte Finish with Gold-Tone Trim
This vintage Sheaffer writing set represents a classic piece of 1980s corporate advertising history, featuring the iconic Pepsi "Choice of a New Generation" branding. The set consists of a ballpoint pen and a mechanical pencil, both finished in a professional matte black with elegant gold-tone hardware. As a collaborative piece, it combines Sheaffer's mid-century reputation for reliable writing instruments with the bold marketing aesthetic of one of the world's most recognizable beverage brands.
Matte black barrel construction with contrasting gold-tone clips and decorative bands
Custom Pepsi globe logo emblems mounted on the pocket clips
"PEPSI. THE CHOICE OF A NEW GENERATION." printed in gold-tone script on the pen barrel
Each instrument measures 5" in length and includes the original Sheaffer presentation box
Condition:
Very good vintage condition. The matte black finish is well-preserved with only minor surface handling marks. The gold-tone trim remains bright, and the Pepsi logo inserts are intact with vibrant color. The mechanical components of both the pen and pencil are functional. No testing has been performed on the ink supply or lead capacity. The original box is included and shows light storage wear.

description: This lot includes four vintage used vacuum tubes from National brand: 2C39 and 7289 models. Made in the USA, these tubes feature metal and ceramic construction. They were typically used as radio frequency power amplifiers in industrial, military, and amateur radio equipment. Decorative Rock and Crystal Collection Lot
Rose Quartz, Amethyst, Agate, Quartz, and River Stone
10" x 10" x 5"
Unsigned
This eclectic collection of decorative minerals and natural stones features a central Rose Quartz gem tree handcrafted with twisted wire and mounted on a sparkling Amethyst druzy cluster base. The lot includes a matched pair of Agate geode halves with polished faces revealing banded crystalline structures, along with several substantial raw clear Quartz specimens and a variety of smooth, polished river stones in basalt and granite tones. This assembly offers a diverse range of textures and colors, suitable for geological interest or holistic interior decor.
Hand-twisted wire Rose Quartz gem tree on an authentic Amethyst cluster base
Matched pair of natural Agate geode halves with polished interior faces
Includes raw Quartz points, polished river stones, and a large jasper-toned specimen
Condition:
The collection is in good decorative condition. As natural mineral specimens, the items exhibit inherent geological inclusions, internal fractures, and raw edges. The gem tree wire is stable and adjustable, and the polished stones show minimal surface scuffing from handling.

Set of Orthoceras Fossils from Silurian Morocco Polished Shell Specimens
This listing offers a set of Orthoceras fossils from the Silurian period, sourced from Morocco. The fossils are embedded in a dark gray matrix and feature well-preserved, polished shell segments with distinct chamber divisions characteristic of Orthoceras cephalopods. The set includes multiple pieces of varying sizes, with the largest measuring approximately 18 cm (7 inches) in length. A labeled mounting plate with specimen information is attached on the back. Fossils are in good condition with natural surface variations, suitable for collectors, educational purposes, or decorative display.
